outcome: Turn-based actions happen before state-based actions are checked and before triggered abilities go on the stack.
After the untap step begins, the active player's phased-in phasing permanents phase out and their phased-out permanents phase in simultaneously.
After phasing in the untap step, an existing day or night designation changes according to the previous turn's spells cast.
The active player untaps all permanents that untap, simultaneously.
After the draw step begins, the active player draws a card.

note: Archenemy schemes are not played in a two-player game.

outcome: After the precombat main phase begins, the active player puts a lore counter on each of their Sagas with chapter abilities.
After lore counters are placed, the active player controlling Attractions rolls to visit them.

note: Only applies when opponents do not all automatically become defending players, which cannot occur in two-player games.
Declaring attackers is a player decision; its legality is covered by 508.
Declaring blockers is a player decision; its legality is covered by 509.
Announcing combat damage assignment is a player decision; the damage itself is 703.4m.

outcome: All combat damage is dealt simultaneously.
At cleanup the active player discards down to maximum hand size.
At cleanup all damage is removed from permanents and until-end-of-turn effects end simultaneously.
Unspent mana empties from mana pools as each step or phase ends.
